walk.note: Walking is free. Plans only offer it up to 1.5 miles each way, and the app warns when the bags get heavy.

uber.basis: Fitted to Uber's own published 1-month average UberX prices from New Haven: to Milford $20 (about 10 mi) and to Orange $19 (about 7 mi), uber.com route pages viewed 2026-10-25. Real fares change with surge pricing, traffic and time of day.

zipcar.included: gas, insurance, up to 180 miles per day
zipcar.basis: Zipcar shows rates per car only in its app. $11/hour is the top of the 2026 '$7.50-11/hr' range reported by a third-party comparison page and matches Stanford's posted $11/hr; Yale's own page lists no price. You can change the rate in the app's settings.
